The tray holds a banana, two oat or flapjack-style biscuit pieces, a glass of chocolate milk and a small bottle of milk. These are rough estimates from the photo.

Estimated energy per item:
- Banana, medium: about 105 kcal, with 1 g protein, 27 g carbs and 0.4 g fat.
- Biscuit pieces: about 2 pieces at 90 kcal each, so 180 kcal, with 3 g protein, 28 g carbs and 6 g fat.
- Chocolate milk, about 200 ml: about 140 kcal, with 7 g protein, 20 g carbs and 4 g fat.
- Milk bottle, about 200 ml of whole milk: about 130 kcal, with 7 g protein, 9.5 g carbs and 7 g fat.

Total served is about 555 kcal.

The photo is taken before eating, so I have to guess what will be left over. I assume the person eats most of it and leaves a small amount, about 60 kcal, such as part of the biscuit or some milk.

Eaten is therefore about 495 kcal. I scaled the macros down slightly from the full totals of 18 g protein, 84.5 g carbs and 17.4 g fat.
